power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_starti: Yettwacreḍ s tkerrist n wuzzal Unbreaking II.
origins.neoorigins.class_blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
origins.neoorigins.class_blacksmith.desc: Ameẓlu ameqqran i yesɛan iferdisen n tɣara ifazen, i yesɛan tifrat deg useggem.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_repair: Aṣeggem n tbaḍnit yeswa drus n ssuma yerna yettarra-d ugar n teɣzi.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_forge_: Ifassen ilemẓiyen ttruẓun ablaḍ am tkerrist n weblaḍ.
Yettḍurru s uzgen seg tmes, laẓ, amagma, d tmes  aglim yeqquren.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_starti: Seqcer s 4 n yiɣewwaṛen n wuzzal akken ad tebdu temẓin.
origins.neoorigins.class_cook.name: Kuk
origins.neoorigins.class_cook.descriptio: Amazzag n tkuzint i yesɛan učči i d-yettwafeṣṣlen ugar, yerna i d-yettawin XP deg ukeyyef.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_food.name: učči yelhan
power.neoorigins.class_cook_food.descrip: Učči i d-tessewwayeḍ ad ak-d-yefk laẓ d wučči.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_iron_stomach: Ur d-tettḍurru ara laẓ d uɛebbuḍ.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_seasoned_pal: Tazmert n txuṣṣ deg-k tettɣimi ugar s 25%.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_knife.name: Lmus n Cook
power.neoorigins.class_cook_knife.descri: Yeffeɣ-d s ujenwi n wuzzal  yal asewwi yeḥwaǧ ajenwi yelhan.
origins.neoorigins.class_merchant.name: Amzenzi
origins.neoorigins.class_merchant.descri: Amzenziɣ iẓewren, win iwumi ur ttɛedday ara tnezzut n taddart, i d-yettafen tiɣawsiwin d tixeṭṭay deg ifassen n yimzenziyen.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_trades.d: Werǧin ad k-teffu tnezzut n taddart.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_rare_loo: Imzenziyen yettmenṭaren ad ak-d-fken tiɣin n tmetti n uswir agejdan akked tegnit ad d-tafeḍ agerruj yuqan.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_starting: Ffer-d s usmirag akken ad teẓẓuḍ taḥanut-ik tamezwarut.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_silver_t: Asenfaṛ yeṭṭef-ik-id ugar n 15 %  tamuɣli teṭṭef-ik.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_lucky_tr: +1 n ẓẓher  ẓẓher yettaf-d win yelhan.
origins.neoorigins.class_cleric.name: Ameskar
origins.neoorigins.class_cleric.descript: Amussnaw aḥerfi yesɛan tizemmar n usekḥer meqqren d teɣzi ɣezzifen n tfesna.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_enchanting: Ṭṭabla taḥerfit tettmuddu-d tiḥḥerfitin igerrzen ugar ɣer tama-k.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_potions.de: Ayen akk i d-yettawin yiẓidanen ad yeqqim snat n tikkal ugar.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_turn_undea: Aḍebsi ɣef wid ur nemmut ara ad ten-yeǧǧ d ixuṣṣen i 4 n tsinin.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_divine_sig: Yettwali akken iwata deg tafat meẓẓiyen  d asefk seg usawen.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_starting_b: Yefka-d adlis ad t-yaru yiwen i tẓallit d tezmilin.
origins.neoorigins.class_nitwit.name: Nitwit
origins.neoorigins.class_nitwit.descript: Ur ssineɣ ula deg kra. Tikwal abrid fessusen i ilaqen.
origins.neoorigins.class_fisher.name: Fiṣer
origins.neoorigins.class_fisher.descript: Tudert ɣef yiri n waman  tettawi-d ẓẓher-is seg tmiwa, tettɛummu am uferṭeḥ, tebda-d s uɛekkaz n lbaraka.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_waters_luc: +1 ẓẓher deg waman  ad k-iɛǧeb uḥemmal.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_swim_speed: +15% n tɣawla n umussu mi ara yili deg waman.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_sea_legs.d: Azgen n uɣelluy d lmeḥna - ifassen nnumen s telqey.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_starting_r: Yeffeɣ-d s uẓeṭṭa n useyyeḍ s Luck of the Sea I d Lure I.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_night_sigh: Yettawi-d tamuɣli n yiḍ mi ara yili ddaw waman.
origins.neoorigins.class_mason.name: Amaṣṣut
origins.neoorigins.class_mason.descripti: Aẓru yettaǧǧa-t ufus n win yesɛan tamusni  yerẓa tiḥnacin s tɣawla, ifassen i d-yettwaɣalen ttarran-d i tfekka-s, ma d aqeṛṛu yezga deg ufus-is.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_stone_hands: Ifassen ilemẓiyen ttruẓun ablaḍ am tkerrist n weblaḍ.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_strong_grip: + 1 n uɛekkaz agaman seg tudert-is akk deg tuqqna n uɛekkaz.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_stone_speed: Aseḥbes n usewḥel d arurad s 25%.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_starting_pi: Yettunefk-d s Efficiency I stone tazeqquct.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_block_reach: + 1 n useqdec n yiḥedran  iɣil n uẓeṭṭa yeẓra anida ara ifakk lḥiḍ.
origins.neoorigins.class_paladin.name: Paladin
origins.neoorigins.class_paladin.descrip: Amennuɣ azedgan  wid ur nemmut, ttuɣalen ɣer uḍar, tiɣimit ur tezmir ad teṭṭef, tafat n ufeǧǧeǧ tesseḥlu lǧerḥ.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_turn_unde: Aḍebsi ɣef wid ur nemmut ara ad ten-yeǧǧ d ixuṣṣen i 4 n tsinin.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_holy_armo: +2 n yiɣallen igamanen  tafat ad kem-tḥudd.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_beacon_re: Ad d-yernu s ttawil ma yella deg 8 n yiḥedran n beacon.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_effect_im: Immun to Wither  ur yezmir ara ad k-id-yennal ubeḥri-nni.
origins.neoorigins.necromancer.name: Necromancer
origins.neoorigins.necromancer.descripti: Amεellem n lmut i yḥekmen ɣef imdanen ur nemmut ara. — wither skeletons d imeskaren i yettnaɣen ɣer tama-m, maca tazmert-ik n tudert teqqen ɣer wayla-nsen.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_summon_with: Suter-d aqejjir ad yennaɣ ɣef lǧal-ik. Max 2 ɣef tikelt. Yeswa 6 n yiɣef. 30 n tasinin n usemmiḍ. Ad teṭṭfeḍ 1 n lǧerḥ ma yemmut deg umennuɣ.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_summon_skel: Siwel-d i umẓiw n yiɣes akken ad yennaɣ ɣef lǧal-ik. Max 3 ɣef tikelt. Yeswa 4 n yiɣef. 20 n tasinin n usemmiḍ. Ad teṭṭfeḍ 1 n lǧerḥ ma yemmut deg umennuɣ.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_entity_grou: Yettwabedren d ur nemmut ara. Yettwaḍurru s tezmert taswiεt, yettwaḥlu s lexṣara taswiεt, ur yettwaṭṭaf ara ssem. Yettwaḍurru s lmeḥna.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_water_breat: Ur yeḥwaǧ ara ad yesnuffes. Yezmer ad yidir i lebda ddaw waman.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_night_visio: Yezmer ad iwali akken iwata deg tillas tummidt. Senfel s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
power.neoorigins.necromancer_daylight_da: Yettḍurru s 1,5 deg tasint mi ara d-yeffeɣ i yiṭij srid.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_reduced_hea: -3 n wulawen (-6 HP afellay). Tafekka yettwaḥerrek s ssḥur n tmettant.
Asnulfu n tdawsa tagamant yuder ɣer 40% n tannumi.
origins.neoorigins.gorgon.name: Gurgun
origins.neoorigins.gorgon.description: Aḥeckul n uglim n weblaḍ, i d-yettuɣalen tmuɣli-s d aẓru, i d-yettruẓun ifassen-is  maca taẓayt n weblaḍ tesseḥbibir deg yal asurif.
Ad isewḥel akk iɛdawen iqerben s Slowness V. Yeswa 3 n tfesniwin. 15 n tasinin n usemmiḍ.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_stone_fists.name: Stone Fists
power.neoorigins.gorgon_stone_fists.desc: Yettak-d 4 n wuguren-nniḍen deg yiwen n umennuɣ.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_granite_hide.des: Ammesten ameɣlal I  aglim n weblaḍ yessemsawi yal aẓeṭṭa.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_heavy_frame.name: Punderous
power.neoorigins.gorgon_heavy_frame.desc: Iteddu s 20% s ttawil ɣef tannumi.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_size.name: Aserreḥ s waṭas
power.neoorigins.gorgon_hunger_drain.des: Yesseṛɣay tazmert s 50% s zzerb  aḥraz n talɣa n weblaḍ yettruẓu.
origins.neoorigins.automaton.name: Awurman
origins.neoorigins.automaton.description: Aɣewwaṛ amikanik ur nɣelleq, ur yettmettat ula s laẓ  maca tisseḥlafin n usellek ttfecleqent, tiririt tagamant d agris, yal asurif ẓẓay.
power.neoorigins.automaton_iron_frame.de: Azbu aɣezfan I  akatar n wuzzal ur yettruẓu ara.
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_drown.name: Aṣasi yettwamedlen
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_drown.desc: Ur yeḥwaǧ ara nnefs. Ur yezmir ara ad yeɣreq.
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_hunger.des: Werǧin ad yelluẓ. Yetteddu s uɣbalu n tnezmert agensan.
power.neoorigins.automaton_hide_hunger_b: Afeggag n laẓ yeffer  iwurmanen ur tetten ara.
Afeggag n ubeḥri yeffer  iwurmanen ur ttneffusen ara.
power.neoorigins.automaton_potion_resist: Immun à Regeneration, Instant Health, akked Poison- D ayen i d-tenna. Mazal llan waṭas n yiɣawsiwen nniḍen i d-yellan.
Inermasen iẓrawanen i d-yettwasbedden ttaǧǧan tamuɣli tban deg tillas. Senfel s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
power.neoorigins.automaton_heavy_chassis: Iteddu s leεqel n 15%  akatar ẓẓayen, isurifen ẓẓayen.
Timsujjit tagamant tettili s tfesna n 25  tettwaxdem akken ad teṭṭef, mačči akken ad teḥlu.
power.neoorigins.automaton_knockback_res: Azal n tnekra n uḍegger d 40%.
origins.neoorigins.kraken.name: Kraken
origins.neoorigins.kraken.description: Aḥeckul ameqqran n yilel lqayen i d-ilulen deg ugaraw yeldin  yessexlaɛen ddaw waman s yifeṭṭiḍen n yifeṭṭiḍen-is, s yifeṭṭiḍen n tqeffalt, d yimeḥḍaren i d-yessawlen, maca yeɣli ɣer teftist, yeṛɣa-t yiṭij, yeqqur deg ugelmim.
power.neoorigins.kraken_tentacle_lash.de: Yettarra-d tiṭṭawin n tili ara yesderɣalen daɣen ad ssenɣalen akk iɛdawen deg 6 n yiḥedran. Ssuma-s d 2 n tifin. 6 n tsinin n usewḥel.
power.neoorigins.kraken_ink_shot.name: Tuṭṭfa n tqeffalt
power.neoorigins.kraken_ink_shot.descrip: Yettḍeyyiḍ-d s tqeffalt n tqeffalt i yesnernayen aṭas icenga deg uzgen n 5 n yiḥedran. Yeswa 2 n yiɣef. 8 n tsinin n usewḥel.
Yettneffis ddaw waman i lebda, yettwali akken ilaq deg waman war tagut.
